What It Means Logically: Wide Open: Total breathing room. Traffic flows effortlessly.
Light Traffic: Plenty of room for lane changing and overtaking.
Fluid Movement: High speeds, vehicles easily bypass each other.
The Textbook Threshold: The theoretical limit where standard cars lock up lanes.
Highly Efficient Peak: Low space occupancy, yet moving high volumes.
Comfortable Congestion: Lanes are filling, but traffic moves smoothly.
Local Friction Bottleneck: Not fully packed, yet speeds have collapsed.
Approaching Limit: High capacity utilization, approaching the textbook line.
Highly Saturated: Exceeds textbook limits by 13%. Very tight spacing.
Extreme Packing: Over half the pavement length is occupied by metal.
